about: A fast, self-hosted web scraper and crawler with an API, written in Rust.

prs.title: Code from Python docs sites stays a code block
prs.broken: Code blocks without an inner code tag, as on docs.python.org and Read the Docs, came out broken: comments became headings and indented code was split apart.
prs.changed: These blocks are now written as fenced code blocks.
prs.matters: Scraped documentation keeps its code examples intact.
